## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 364 captures during December 2019. Activity is reported for the month as a whole, with the available session records showing that photographic work proceeded as expected. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. No further operational variation is recorded in the source information.

The activity total provides the basis for the image quality and grading results reported below. It should therefore be read alongside the number of images that were suitable for assessment and the results subsequently identified as referable.

## Image quality

Of the 364 captures, 17 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.7 per cent. These images could not be used for grading, and the result is recorded separately from the referable outcome.

## Grading

The site recorded 64 referable results. The median lag for grading was 2. This figure describes the central grading interval reported for the month. Together, the activity, image quality and grading information provide the operational summary for West Gate Eye Clinic in December 2019.
